findings.title: Reverts prior fix that guaranteed Jinja2 autoescaping, restoring deprecated env_options path
findings.problem: Root CLAUDE.md Security section (absolute): 'in Jinja2, never apply | safe to user content or disable autoescaping.' This diff reverts e11187e, whose message says Starlette removed the **env_options passthrough, breaking autoescape=True on newer versions. Confirmed in installed starlette/templating.py 90-96 that the kwarg routes through **env_options, flagged deprecated. pyproject pins fastapi with no ceiling, so a future upgrade to a starlette dropping the passthrough would silently disable autoescaping project-wide.
findings.fix_hint: Restore the preconfigured jinja2.Environment pattern from e11187e: jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) passed via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env).
findings.why_it_matters: If the installed starlette drops the deprecated passthrough, autoescape silently stops with no error, reopening every Jinja2-rendered response to reflected XSS.

members.title: Reverts to Jinja2Templates env-options kwarg form that installed starlette 0.52.1 explicitly deprecates
members.problem: In starlette 0.52.1 Jinja2Templates.__init__ puts autoescape=True into **env_options and warns DeprecationWarning. The diff undoes e11187e, which moved to the supported env= form for exactly this reason. The kwarg still works but is redundant: _create_env already calls env_options.setdefault('autoescape', True). e11187e's message says starlette 'removed' the passthrough, which does not match 0.52.1 (deprecates only); confirm which starlette the Docker image resolves (fastapi unpinned).

members.why_it_matters: Autoescaping is the app's XSS defense for every template. Leaning on a deprecated passthrough means a future starlette release could reject the kwarg and crash at import; fastapi/starlette are not pinned. Emits DeprecationWarning at every import.
members.fix_hint: Either drop autoescape=True (directory= path already defaults autoescape to True, no warning) or restore the env=jinja2.Environment(loader=..., autoescape=True) form from e11187e.

members.title: Revert of deliberate autoescape fix reintroduces dependency on deprecated Starlette passthrough
members.problem: Reverts e11187e. Verified against installed starlette 0.52.1 that Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) still autoescapes today but raises DeprecationWarning on every startup. Jinja2's own Environment defaults autoescape=False; if a future Starlette drops **env_options forwarding, this line would silently stop escaping all template output. No | safe filters found, so no compensating control.

members.title: Diff undoes fix e11187e by going back to Starlette's deprecated Jinja2Templates(**env_options) path
members.problem: Reverses commit e11187e. Installed Starlette 0.52.1 still accepts **env_options but always raises DeprecationWarning ('Extra environment options are deprecated. Use a preconfigured jinja2.Environment instead.'). Importing triggarr.web.routes with -W error::DeprecationWarning fails at this line. fastapi/starlette are unpinned in pyproject.toml. When a Starlette release drops **env_options, autoescape=True will raise TypeError at import and the web app will not start. On the current version behavior is unchanged: _create_env defaults autoescape to True, so the kwarg adds nothing but the warning.

members.title: Reverts the e11187e fix: deprecated Jinja2Templates(**env_options) path, with an unpinned Starlette in the Docker build
members.problem: Reverts e11187e. In starlette 0.52.1 extra keywords go to **env_options and trigger DeprecationWarning (starlette/templating.py:92-93). Confirmed: python -W error -c 'import triggarr.web.routes' raises at routes.py:45; pytest shows the warning. App works today: templates.env.autoescape is True, 466 tests pass. Risk is the build: pyproject lists fastapi with no bound and Dockerfile:31 runs pip install . ignoring uv.lock, so the next image build picking a Starlette without the passthrough raises TypeError at import and the container won't start. Autoescape doesn't fail silently on this path (_create_env defaults True); realistic failure is a crash.

members.why_it_matters: Every user of the ghcr.io/thejuran/triggarr image could get a container that fails at startup after a routine rebuild. Web UI and scheduler share one import path, so the result is a complete outage.
members.fix_hint: Keep the pre-diff Jinja2Templates(env=jinja2.Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True)) form (drop this revert), or pin fastapi/starlette upper bounds and install from uv.lock in the Dockerfile.

members.title: Autoescape now depends on deprecated, version-dependent Starlette behavior instead of explicit Environment construction
members.problem: Before, routes.py built the jinja2.Environment itself with autoescape=True explicit in this repo. After, autoescape depends on Starlette forwarding a deprecated keyword plus Starlette's own setdefault('autoescape', True). Autoescape currently on (verified). Most likely future failure is TypeError, not autoescape quietly off; no concrete path to False found.
